title: LLMTrace Attack Scenario
description: Declarative attack scenario consumed by the e2e adversarial test framework. One YAML file per scenario under benchmarks/attacks/<family>/<id>.yaml. See SCHEMA.md for canonical enums and field semantics.

id.description: Globally unique scenario id. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.

source.description: Human-readable attribution of the attack origin (paper, dataset, observed incident).

prompt.description: Verbatim attack prompt sent to the proxy. Multi-line allowed.

system_prompt_canary.description: Optional system-prompt fragment whose first 40 chars must NOT appear in the upstream response. Used by the L8 upstream-fell-for-it detector.

expected.description: Tolerant expectations evaluated against the proxy decision, finding deltas, and (optionally) the judge verdict. Dotted keys (proxy_outcome.at_least, etc.) are flat string keys; the dot is part of the key, not a path.

proxy_outcome.at_least.description: Minimum acceptable proxy outcome (allow < warn < block).

proxy_outcome.at_most.description: Maximum acceptable proxy outcome (allow < warn < block).

findings_include.description: Each entry must appear at least once as the finding_type label on the per-scenario delta of llmtrace_security_findings_total.

findings_min_severity.description: Peak severity across observed findings must be >= this value (Info < Low < Medium < High < Critical).

judge_verdict.description: Assertions against the judge verdict polled from /debug/judge/verdicts. Optional — scenarios that run with the judge disabled omit this block.

zone_detection_enabled.description: When true, the harness skips this scenario unless the proxy is running with zone detection enabled (env LLMTRACE_ZONE_DETECTION_ENABLED=true). Lets IS-060 PR-1 ship asserting scenarios without breaking the PR-gate when the flag is off.

tags.description: Free-form selection tags. Reserved values include 'pr-gate' (selects the scenario into the PR-gate subset).

upstream_fell_for_it.description: Optional. Drives the L8 upstream-fell-for-it detector. Boolean form is the legacy compact spelling; the object form lets a scenario contribute its own substring/regex canaries (regex matches use the 're:' prefix).

expected.description: Whether the upstream is expected to comply with the attack. When set, the harness asserts; when omitted, the judgement is purely observational.

canaries.description: Per-scenario substrings or regex patterns the harness searches for in the upstream response. Plain strings match as substrings; entries prefixed with 're:' compile as regex.

skip.description: Lifecycle hook to temporarily exclude the scenario. The reason field is mandatory whenever skip is present so dormant scenarios always carry an explanation.

reason.description: Why this scenario is currently skipped. Required.

until.description: Optional unblock date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The harness logs a warning past this date.
